\subsubsection{\texttt{case-index}: Case index}
\label{sec:contract-case-index}

Catalog row case-index 1.0.0: the inventory of cases the site serves (data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}manifests/\allowbreak{}index.\allowbreak{}json).\allowbreak{} The contract carries schema 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}core/\allowbreak{}manifest.\allowbreak{}py}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}schemas/\allowbreak{}common/\allowbreak{}case-\allowbreak{}index.\allowbreak{}schema.\allowbreak{}json}; the committed documents it governs are data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}manifests/\allowbreak{}index.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}documents.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}index\_\allowbreak{}validates}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/\allowbreak{}src/\allowbreak{}lib/\allowbreak{}contract.\allowbreak{}test.\allowbreak{}ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: missing: copy-data stops the site build (no site without an inventory); at run time getJSON throws Artifact\allowbreak{}Error (an HTTP status or a non-JSON answer); a view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, and the C04 result sections show a LoadError alert (data-state error), never an empty chart. stale: engine\_\allowbreak{}version differs from VERSION (the index records the engine that baked it). Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}manifests/\allowbreak{}index.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}documents.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}every\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}matches\_\allowbreak{}exactly\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}schema\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}validates}. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is baseline:data-\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}model/\allowbreak{}benchmark.\allowbreak{}py.\allowbreak{} The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}model\_\allowbreak{}slot.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}swap\_\allowbreak{}baseline\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}fitted\_\allowbreak{}rungs}. and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C10 loan-type artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws Artifact\allowbreak{}Error; the C10 view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A value the bake may lack is nullable with its reason in the document, never a number (a year with a missing quarter has a null rate and its reason, never an interpolated one; a rung that did not run has no measure and its reason; an ES the method does not define is null with its reason). \subsubsection{\texttt{c12-outputs}: C12 variant (swap exposure, CVA and SA-CCR)}
\label{sec:contract-c12-outputs}

One variant of case C12 (swap exposure, CVA and SA-CCR): the six the design document variants share this schema and are told apart by outputs.\allowbreak{}variant.\allowbreak{} Every object is closed and nothing is optional; a block a variant does not run is null. The contract carries schema 2.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}cases/\allowbreak{}c12/\allowbreak{}}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}schemas/\allowbreak{}c12/\allowbreak{}variant-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}exposure.\allowbreak{}schema.\allowbreak{}json}; the committed documents it governs are data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}C12/\allowbreak{}*.\allowbreak{}json, !data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}C12/\allowbreak{}models-\allowbreak{}hw1f-\allowbreak{}treasury-\allowbreak{}2000-\allowbreak{}2025.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}c12/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}c12\_\allowbreak{}documents.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}every\_\allowbreak{}committed\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}validates\_\allowbreak{}passes\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}checks\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}listed\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}its\_\allowbreak{}hash}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u9/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u9\_\allowbreak{}fixes.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}every\_\allowbreak{}accepted\_\allowbreak{}plant\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}review\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}refused}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/\allowbreak{}src/\allowbreak{}lib/\allowbreak{}contract.\allowbreak{}test.\allowbreak{}ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C12 variant artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws Artifact\allowbreak{}Error; the C12 view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A Treasury tenor absent on the curve date is listed in curve.\allowbreak{}tenors\_\allowbreak{}absent with the tenors present, never interpolated silently; the ORE reconciliation is status reconciled for every variant but the wrong-way one (ORE reconciles the single swap, the netting set, both CSA variants and the initial-\allowbreak{}margin variant, S2) and not-\allowbreak{}applicable with its reason for the wrong-way variant only (ORE's example is a different model); an ORE run that fails stops the bake, the variant is not written and is never published as not-\allowbreak{}applicable; a calibration whose sample window ends on or after its backtest date fails; the IM block is a regression proxy and never SIMM. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}fixtures/\allowbreak{}c12/\allowbreak{}variant-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}exposure-\allowbreak{}single-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}fixture.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} Table~\ref{tab:contract-c12-outputs} lists its 31 top-level fields with the type, the unit, the range or the values and the description.\allowbreak{}

\subsubsection{\texttt{c12-models}: C12 models (HW1F calibration per backtest date)}
\label{sec:contract-c12-models}

The C12 models document: the Hull-White one-factor calibration per backtest date with its sample window, the counterparty curve, the transcribed GIRR parameters and the stated limits. The contract carries schema 2.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}cases/\allowbreak{}c12/\allowbreak{}}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}schemas/\allowbreak{}c12/\allowbreak{}models.\allowbreak{}schema.\allowbreak{}json}; the committed documents it governs are data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}C12/\allowbreak{}models-\allowbreak{}hw1f-\allowbreak{}treasury-\allowbreak{}2000-\allowbreak{}2025.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}c12/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}c12\_\allowbreak{}documents.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}every\_\allowbreak{}committed\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}validates\_\allowbreak{}passes\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}checks\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}listed\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}its\_\allowbreak{}hash}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u9/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u9\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}a\_\allowbreak{}planted\_\allowbreak{}defect\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}refused}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u9/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u9\_\allowbreak{}fixes.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}refuses\_\allowbreak{}a\_\allowbreak{}short\_\allowbreak{}window\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}too\_\allowbreak{}few\_\allowbreak{}observations}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u9/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u9\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}calibration\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}date\_\allowbreak{}ends\_\allowbreak{}before\_\allowbreak{}that\_\allowbreak{}date\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}has\_\allowbreak{}three\_\allowbreak{}years}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u9/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u9\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}girr\_\allowbreak{}parameters\_\allowbreak{}are\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}transcribed\_\allowbreak{}r7\_\allowbreak{}values}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/\allowbreak{}src/\allowbreak{}lib/\allowbreak{}contract.\allowbreak{}test.\allowbreak{}ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: the C12 models artifact is absent; loadCase throws Artifact\allowbreak{}Error for every C12 variant; the Model views show their Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there. A calibration date lacking three years of history before it is not written (the bake refuses), never a guessed parameter; a negative HQM-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}Treasury spread is set to zero and counted, never carried; the counterparty curve is labelled a proxy and the Treasury-\allowbreak{}side licence sentence is stated UNVERIFIED. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}fixtures/\allowbreak{}c12/\allowbreak{}models-\allowbreak{}fixture.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} Table~\ref{tab:contract-c12-models} lists its 7 top-level fields with the type, the unit, the range or the values and the description.\allowbreak{}

\texttt{outputs.\allowbreak{}eve} & object (c15\allowbreak{}Eve\allowbreak{}Measure) & none (record) & see its fields & Annex 1 delta EVE: the maximum over the six shocks of the pair total (there is no other currency in this book). \\

\subsubsection{\texttt{c15-models}: C15 models}
\label{sec:contract-c15-models}

Catalog row c15-models 1.0.0: the C15 models artifact (buckets, the CMF Annex 1 table, floors, thresholds, curve fits, calibration targets, behavioural fits). The contract carries schema 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}cases/\allowbreak{}c15/\allowbreak{}}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}schemas/\allowbreak{}c15/\allowbreak{}models.\allowbreak{}schema.\allowbreak{}json}; the committed documents it governs are data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}C15/\allowbreak{}models-\allowbreak{}banco-\allowbreak{}andino-\allowbreak{}2026-\allowbreak{}09.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}c15/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}c15\_\allowbreak{}documents.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}six\_\allowbreak{}variants\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}validate\_\allowbreak{}pass\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}checks\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}are\_\allowbreak{}listed\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}their\_\allowbreak{}hash}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u10/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u10\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}c15\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}carry\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}annex1\_\allowbreak{}table\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}floors\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}thresholds\_\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}transcribed}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u10/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u10\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}semantic\_\allowbreak{}checker\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}clean\_\allowbreak{}on\_\allowbreak{}every\_\allowbreak{}committed\_\allowbreak{}c14\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}c15\_\allowbreak{}document}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u10/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u10\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}a\_\allowbreak{}planted\_\allowbreak{}defect\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}refused\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}schema\_\allowbreak{}or\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}checker}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u10/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u10\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}fixture\_\allowbreak{}exists\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}discovered\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}exactly\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C15 models artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws Artifact\allowbreak{}Error; the C15 view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A value the bake may lack is nullable with its reason in the document, never a number (a dash of the Annex 1 Hoja 9 table is null; a margin volatility the fit lacks is null with its reason). Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}fixtures/\allowbreak{}c15/\allowbreak{}models-\allowbreak{}fixture.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u10/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u10\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}fixture\_\allowbreak{}exists\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}discovered\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}exactly\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}schema}. A value the bake may lack is nullable with its reason in the document, never a number (a call-report item the FDIC financials lack has reported\_\allowbreak{}amount null with its reason and the assumption that replaces it; the H.8 aggregate record is null with its reason when the release tables are not read; a variant with no daily path (the LCR) holds path, cliff, the event-\allowbreak{}horizon outflow and the uninsured-\allowbreak{}share and HTM-loss sensitivities null with their reasons; a survival period is a number only where the NLP turns negative and 'survives the horizon' with the horizon otherwise; call reports dated after the valuation date are never read, a false read\_\allowbreak{}up\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}valuation\_\allowbreak{}date fails; a Table A.1 row beyond the ladder's horizon has a null share with its reason; an empty HQLA stock has null Level 2 and Level 2B shares with their reason in shares\_\allowbreak{}reason, never a zero, and shares\_\allowbreak{}reason is null where the shares are numbers). Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}fixtures/\allowbreak{}c16/\allowbreak{}variant-\allowbreak{}scenario-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}adverse-\allowbreak{}fixture.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u11/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u11\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}fixture\_\allowbreak{}exists\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}discovered\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}exactly\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}schema}. \texttt{outputs.\allowbreak{}scenario\_\allowbreak{}influence} & object (c17\allowbreak{}Scenario\allowbreak{}Influence) & none (record) & see its fields & The 99.9 percent capital's sensitivity to each scenario point of one history (the scenario influence). \\
\texttt{tests} & array of item & none (list) & any length & The tests, as a list of item. \\
\texttt{impact} & object & none (record) & see its fields & The headline quantities of the document, each with its value, its unit and a bilingual label. \\
\texttt{findings} & array of finding.\allowbreak{}schema.\allowbreak{}json & none (list) & any length & A list of: One finding of a variant, with its severity and evidence. \\

the committed documents it governs are data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}C17/\allowbreak{}models-\allowbreak{}generator.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}c17/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}c17\_\allowbreak{}documents.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}every\_\allowbreak{}committed\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}validates\_\allowbreak{}passes\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}semantic\_\allowbreak{}gate\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}listed\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}its\_\allowbreak{}hash}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u12/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u12\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}carries\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}true\_\allowbreak{}parameters\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}quantile\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}every\_\allowbreak{}variant}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u12/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u12\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}variant\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}match\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}variant\_\allowbreak{}fixtures}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts\_\allowbreak{}u12/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}u12\_\allowbreak{}contracts.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}fixture\_\allowbreak{}exists\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}discovered\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}exactly\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}schema}. Catalog row c22-models 2.0.0: the C22 models artifact with the exact-\allowbreak{}probability parity points of the three count tests and the engine's 25 named size and power studies. The contract carries schema 2.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}pipeline/\allowbreak{}cases/\allowbreak{}c22\_\allowbreak{}validator.\allowbreak{}py}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}schemas/\allowbreak{}c22/\allowbreak{}models.\allowbreak{}schema.\allowbreak{}json}; the committed documents it governs are data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}C22/\allowbreak{}models-\allowbreak{}generators.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}documents.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}validate}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}c22\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}families.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}models\_\allowbreak{}artifact\_\allowbreak{}names\_\allowbreak{}the\_\allowbreak{}engine\_\allowbreak{}studies}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/\allowbreak{}src/\allowbreak{}lib/\allowbreak{}contract.\allowbreak{}test.\allowbreak{}ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: the C22 models artifact is absent; loadCase throws Artifact\allowbreak{}Error for every C22 variant. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:data/\allowbreak{}derived/\allowbreak{}C22/\allowbreak{}models-\allowbreak{}generators.\allowbreak{}json.\allowbreak{} The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}contracts/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}documents.\allowbreak{}py::\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}every\_\allowbreak{}document\_\allowbreak{}matches\_\allowbreak{}exactly\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}schema\_\allowbreak{}and\_\allowbreak{}validates}.
